description: Create a task linked to a lead, contact, or company. Set deadline (complete_till as Unix timestamp) and task type (1=Call, 2=Meeting, 3=Email).

complete_till.description: Unix timestamp — deadline for the task

entity_id.description: ID of the linked entity (lead, contact, or company)

task_type_id.description: Task type ID (1=Call, 2=Meeting, 3=Email). Use get_account to see all types.

name: create_task
